Definition: Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Ashtaroth or Astaroth = "star"; n pr f deity; 1) false goddesses in the Canaanite religion, usually related to fertility cult; n pr loc; 2) a city in Bashan east of the Jordan given to Manasseh; 2a) same as H06255
